proposals.topic_summary: Requests a board policy requiring the initial list of director candidates to include qualified women and minority candidates, including from third-party consultants.

proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REGARDING A POLICY TO REQUIRE AN INDEPENDENT BOARD CHAIR
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a policy and bylaw amendment requiring the Board Chair to be an independent director, with limited waivers.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends that you vote against this proposal.

proposals.title: SHAREHOLDER PROPOSAL REGARDING VOTE-COUNTING PRACTICES FOR SHAREHOLDER PROPOSALS
proposals.topic_summary: Requests amending governing documents so non-binding shareholder proposals are decided by a simple majority of votes cast FOR and AGAINST, excluding abstentions.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends that you vote against this proposal.
